brief: Index of the last array entry equal to a value
description: Return the index of the last entry of array equal to searchElement, searching backward from fromIndex, or -1. Values are compared as includes compares them: by value (equal arrays and objects match), and NaN is found.

parameters.description: Index to start the search at, searching backward. Negative counts from the end. Default: the last index.
parameters.name: fromIndex
